headingText: Sec. 24-3.7. Use of a stolen firearm in the commission of an offense.

blocks.text: Sec. 24-3.7. Use of a stolen firearm in the commission of an offense.

blocks.label: (a)
blocks.text: (a) A person commits the offense of use of a stolen firearm in the commission of an offense when he or she knowingly uses a stolen firearm in the commission of any offense and the person knows that the firearm was stolen.

blocks.label: (b)
blocks.text: (b) Sentence. Use of a stolen firearm in the commission of an offense is a Class 2 felony.
